scenes.label: Meet Rohan
scenes.title: Nani’s new helper
scenes.caption: Meet Rohan. Every Sunday, he helps Nani at her fruit stall. Today, she has a toy sorting machine. Rohan calls it his pet machine! He shows it one shiny red apple and says, "Fruit!" The machine beeps. Rohan thinks it's ready to help.
scenes.dialogue: One apple. Now it knows fruit!

scenes.label: The mix-up
scenes.title: A rock in the fruit basket!
scenes.caption: Then Rohan tests it with a round red rock. Beep! The machine drops it in the fruit basket. Next, a green apple lands on the rock pile! Meera Aunty nearly buys the rock! Rohan feels embarrassed.

scenes.label: Find out why
scenes.title: What did it learn from?
scenes.caption: Nani asks, "What did it learn from?" Just one red apple! So it guessed that red and round means fruit. Rohan understands now. This machine learns from examples. With only one example, it makes silly guesses. It needs more examples, and different ones too.
scenes.dialogue: It only saw one red apple!

scenes.label: Teach the machine
scenes.title: Teach it with better examples
scenes.caption: Your turn! Help Rohan teach the machine. Put different fruits on the Fruit tray and different rocks on the Rock tray. Then press Test. Careful! Lots of red apples may look helpful, but they're all the same.

scenes.label: It learned!
scenes.title: Different examples. Better sorting.
scenes.caption: The machine gets it right now! The red rock goes to the rocks. The green apple goes to the fruit. Machines like this learn from examples, and different examples help. But they still make mistakes, so a person checks too. Nani checks every basket.
scenes.dialogue: Red rock? Rock! Green apple? Fruit!

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: Only fruit in the basket
scenes.caption: Meera Aunty gets only fruit in her bag, and Nani gives Rohan a big hug. He learned that a machine is only as good as its examples. Your turn: help Rohan feed the pet machine new fruits and new objects!
scenes.dialogue: Thanks for helping me teach it!
